html:
Coming to Ba Na, visitors not only visit the scenery or experience the world record cable car, but also enjoy delicious dishes, in a spacious and airy space, very suitable for tourists’ vacation.

Four Seasons Buffet Restaurant

The restaurant is designed spaciously, inspired by the colorful landscape space of the year, Four Seasons restaurant has 3 floors serving Asian – European buffet including 90 dishes, one floor is coffee and cakes, the buffet is located on the remaining 2 floors with summer and autumn buffet dishes, in which the main menu is delicious dishes with Korean flavors.

Rosa Fried Chicken Restaurant

This is an address for fast food lovers when traveling to Ba Na, you cannot miss this address, with menus such as: fried chicken, Bulgogi beef rice, burgers of all kinds…

Rosa Sushi Bar Restaurant

The restaurant with 50 traditional Japanese dishes, from fresh ingredients that look very eye-catching, with an airy space will bring diners delicious flavors, and forever remember the dishes of the Restaurant in Ba Na.

Taiga Buffet Restaurant

The restaurant has 3 floors, the menu includes 90 dishes, bringing the rich flavor of the Central region with dishes such as: Bana wild chayote salad, Lotus root salad with shrimp and meat, Steamed grouper with soy sauce, Artisan roasted duck, Grilled Deo Le chicken with mac mat leaves, Roasted suckling pig, Crispy fried pork belly, Grilled veal…

Le Petrin Restaurant

Le Petrin bakery attracts diners with its strong aroma, and the romantic space will bring diners the most comfort.

Street food

If you have the opportunity to visit Ba Na, visitors should enjoy street food such as: made-in-Ba Na sausages, hotdogs, hamburgers, fragrant grilled skewers, Ba Na orange cakes…

Vietnamese restaurant

The restaurant has a traditional design, and traditional dishes such as green rice ice cream, La Vong fish cakes, spring rolls, Hanoi beef pho,… with the traditional flavors of Vietnamese cuisine.

Lotteria

With fast food, visitors can enjoy while admiring the scenery and ancient buildings, which will bring visitors the most perfect vacation.

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ba Na tour today, to enjoy delicious and attractive dishes, and take a walk to admire the poetic scenery, or immerse yourself in the unique festivals that this place brings to visitors.
